title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Introduction:

Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.


The Role:

As a Junior Software Engineer, you will support a mixture of R&D and product development activities across the full software development lifecycle of cutting-edge autonomous systems.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Primarily, your role will be to implement and test features within our existing software components for autopilots, mission systems, and graphical user interfaces, requiring strong problem-solving and software engineering skills.
  • Proactively engage with other engineers, teams and leadership to ensure needs are understood and met.
  • Get involved in simulation testing, and flight testing at our own field as well as customer demonstrations.
  • Requirements capturing.
  • System architecture.
  • Software development, testing, and ConOps/use case development.


Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • Software engineering experience with one or more modern Object-Oriented Languages, ideally Java or C++, to build modular, testable code.
  • Good working knowledge of Linux.
  • Collaborative working approach.


Desirable:

  • Experience working with autonomous systems and mission software.
  • Knowledge of API design and development using REST, gRPC, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with UI development and database design, including PostgreSQL or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and messaging technologies such as MQTT or RabbitMQ.
  • Experience using CI/CD pipelines and development tools such as Git, Maven, Jenkins, or TeamCity.


Saab UK Company Benefits:

  • 30 days annual leave.
  • Workplace pension scheme with 8% company contribution.
  • Private medical insurance.
  • Group income protection scheme.
  • Death in service insurance.
  • Up to 5% share matching scheme.
  • Company enhanced Maternity/Adoption & Paternity leave.
  • + Much more


By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview.
